reason: I'd take the free listing and the boards, sure. But they don't say who the payment company is, what the fee per transaction is or when the money lands in my account, so I'm not putting QR codes on my tables or paying 59 lari a month on top of that.
objection: A hidden per-transaction fee charged on top, plus 59 lari a month, plus the money maybe arriving days later. I already pay my terminal fee, and my regulars pay cash or card at the counter. I don't need dish ratings.
would_change_my_mind: The partner named, a written fee lower than my current terminal fee, and money in my account the next day. Then I'd try the 3 free months and keep it only if it brings back regulars worth more than 59 lari in the first month after.
